title: Remove player counts from team cards
objective: Reduce visual noise in the primary team-selection flow so visitors can identify a team and its actionable data-readiness state faster.
changes: Removed generic player-count text from team cards in the default browsing state.
Preserved player-name previews only when a search query matches players, because that information directly explains the search result.
Reduced team-card minimum height from 78px to 68px.
Reduced team-card vertical padding and readiness spacing to use the reclaimed space.
guarantees: Matched-player previews remain visible when they are relevant to a search query.
Readiness badges and team-level status remain unchanged.
